messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

The bug is in the slice call — it uses `start + perPage - 1` as the end index, which excludes one element from each page. The end of a JavaScript slice is exclusive, so it should be `start + perPage`.

response.text: The fix was changing `start + perPage - 1` to `start + perPage` in the `items.slice()` call. Since JavaScript's `slice` end index is exclusive, the `- 1` was incorrectly excluding one element from each page (except the last). Both tests now pass.
